_about: The rules for page-layer JavaScript. Engineering signs these off once (python tools/cli.py policy-approve --by <engineer>); if anything under 'rules' changes without a new sign-off, nothing can be approved or published. In the GitHub version, CODEOWNERS gives this folder to engineering.

tiers._about: A page is 'high' risk if its audience is members (most readers signed in) or a path matches high_paths. High-risk pages may only use components engineering has signed off; experiments never run there.
